Join to apply for the Armed Custom Protection Officer Corporate Building role at Allied Universal

Allied Universal, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

We offer comprehensive benefits for most full-time positions, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, life insurance, a retirement plan, employee assistance programs, company discounts, perks, and more.

Allied Universal is hiring a Armed Custom Protection Officer (CPO). The Armed Custom Protection Officer will conduct armed foot and/or vehicle patrol (interior and/or exterior). The Armed Custom Protection Officer will also control access and egress; monitor CCTV and alarm systems; compose reports; deter criminal activity and misconduct.

Pay $25.75 an hour

Paid Weekly!

Responsibilities

  • Perform security patrols of designated areas on foot or in vehicle
  • Watch for irregular or unusual conditions that may create security concerns or safety hazards
  • Sound alarms or calls police or fire department in case of fire or presence of unauthorized persons
  • Warn violators of rule infractions, such as loitering, smoking, or carrying forbidden articles
  • Permit authorized persons to enter property and monitors entrances and exits
  • Observe departing personnel to protect against theft of company property and ensures that authorized removal of property is conducted within appropriate client requirements
  • Investigate and prepare reports on accidents, incidents, and suspicious activities; maintain written logs as required by the post
  • Aid customers, employees, and visitors in a courteous and professional manner
  • Make emergency notifications as necessary pursuant to site Post Orders
  • Make productivity and cost reduction recommendations to management
  • Make recommendations for physical security surveys and post orders

Qualifications (must Have)

  • Must possess a high school diploma or equivalent
  • Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment
  • Must possess one or more of the following:
    • Military service in an occupational specialty related to law enforcement such as military police, combat arms, or special forces
    • Minimum of two (2) years of experience carrying a firearm as a law enforcement officer, with zero disciplinary action for the misuse of firearms or use of force
  • Be at least 21 years of age
  • Be able to operate radio or telephone equipment and/or console monitors
  • Demonstrated ability to interact cordially and communicate with the public
  • Effective oral and written communication
  • Problem solving skills
  • Active listening skills
  • Assess and evaluate situations effectively
  • Identify critical issues quickly and accurately
  • Compile, sort, and interpret data
  • Research, investigate, compile information
  • Mediate conflict with tact, diplomacy
  • Write informatively, clearly, and accurately
  • Teamwork
  • Attention to detail

Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, basic life, AD&D, and disability insurance
  • Enrollment in our company’s 401(k)plan, subject to eligibility requirements
  • Seven holidays annually paid at time and a half, if worked
  • 40 hours of vacation after one year of employment at eligible work assignments. Unused vacation is only paid out where required by law.

​SERIOUS INQUIRIES ONLY. PLEASE DO NOT APPLY IF YOU ARE NOT LOOKING FOR WORK OR HAVE NOT READ THE JOB DESCRIPTION.

Stonewall Protection Group LLC. has a full-time opening for a licensed level III Commissioned Security Officer. This is a day shift position working Monday - Friday, 9:00am - 5:00pm in a professional office environment.

We are seeking a professional and experienced Commissioned Security Officer (Armed) to become an integral part of our team and carry out the following responsibilities:

Responsibilities:

  • Monitor premises to prevent criminal activity
  • Oversee access control to property
  • Warn violators of premise rules and regulations
  • Investigate persons engaging in suspicious or criminal activity
  • Report any facility maintenance issues
  • Request emergency personnel when appropriate
  • Monitor security cameras
  • Complete activity reports
  • Provide quality customer service for all employees and visitors
  • Answer phones and greet visitors

Candidates must meet the following qualifications:

- Candidate must have at least 2 years of verifiable security experience
- Candidate must be at least 21 years old
- Candidate must be a citizen of the United States and/or legally able to work in the United States in accordance with the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986
- Candidate must be drug free for the duration of the contract and be willing to submit to random drug testing.
- Candidate must be able to speak, read, write, and understand English and have excellent verbal communication skills.
- Candidate must be a high school graduate (or equivalent).
- Candidate must possess a valid driver's license and reliable transportation.
- Candidate must possess a Level III commissioned security officer license and be in good standing with the Texas Department of Public Safety.
- Candidate must be in reasonable physical condition to promote a professional appearance in uniform.

Stonewall Protection Group is a private security firm based in Dallas-Fort Worth. Our company provides a variety of security services throughout the metroplex including armed and unarmed security services, executive protection, and consulting services. jobs.description:
About First Responder Protective Services


First Responder Protective Services is a premier provider of private security needs across the U.S. Our company is owned, operated and managed by U.S. Military veterans, law enforcement executives, and corporate business professionals. Our founders have over 60 years of experience in protecting critical infrastructures, combating transnational criminal organizations, mitigating risks, and providing the highest level of safety and security to corporations and communities.


The mission of First Responder Protective Services is to provide the highest level of customer service to each and every client. We accomplish this mission through our foundation of attention to detail, integrity, accountability, empathy, care, and concern for the needs of our clients and the officers which we serve.


Job Title: Non-Commissioned Security Guard (Level II)
Location: Grapevine
Pay: $18-$20 per hour, depending on qualifications (paid weekly)
Status: Full-time & Part-time

Position Summary


First Responder Protective Services (FRPS) is hiring multiple FLEX Non-Commissioned Security Guards to provide a consistent security presence at a controlled-access community in the Grapevine area. This position is primarily based in a spacious, climate-controlled guard shack, where officers will manage access control, monitor video surveillance and access systems, and check residents and visitors in and out of the property. The guard shack is equipped with basic necessities and access to clean, private restroom facilities. Officers will also conduct occasional patrols of the property, both on foot and by golf cart, to maintain visibility and ensure the safety of residents and property. Weekday and weekend shifts are available, with 24/7 coverage required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage check-in/out residents and visitors in a climate controlled shack.
  • Monitor entrances, access points, and surveillance systems.
  • Respond promptly to alarms, emergencies, or incidents.
  • Prepare detailed incident and activity reports as required.
  • Remain alert and proactive in identifying and reporting security concerns
  • Follow all post orders and supervisor instructions
  • Occasional mobile and foot patrol in assigned areas to ensure safety and security of residents, staff, and property.


Requirements

  • Must have at least one year of experience unarmed security.
  • Must hold a current Level II Texas Noncommissioned Security License
  • Must have a valid Texas Driver’s License (or ability to obtain before starting)
  • Professional appearance and demeanor
  • Ability to work independently or with a team
  • Able to sit, stand, or walk for extended periods

Compensation & Advancement

  • Hourly Pay: $18-$20/hour (based on experience and availability)
  • Pay Frequency: Bi-weekly via direct deposit
  • Status: W2 employee (eligible for overtime after 40 hours in a workweek)

Full-Time Employee Benefits
